inviter_text: Invite one new member to join the Garden Club by 30 June. If the new member joins, pays the first monthly fee by that date, and the payment clears, you will receive a $5 café voucher by email within seven days. Current staff are not eligible.
recipient_text: A current Garden Club member has invited you to become a new member. Join and pay the first monthly fee by 30 June. No recipient reward is offered. Join by 30 June.
short_disclosure: For eligible non-staff current members making one invitation. The new member must join and pay the first monthly fee by 30 June, and the payment must clear; the inviter then receives a $5 café voucher by email within seven days.
ineligible_case_response: Staff, people who are not current members, and recipients who are not new members do not meet the supplied eligibility rules.
